name: Novel Support Composition Mixture Holdout Family
description: Tests candidate autonomy predictors against novel joint assistance mixtures (e.g. combined air-command surges or high-logistics/forcegen pairings) that extrapolate beyond the 6 discrete discovery profiles.

experimental_manipulation.support_mixtures: novel interpolations including air_command_joint, logistics_forcegen_joint, and tri_channel_skewed
experimental_manipulation.rationale: Mixture testing verifies that the candidate predictor isolates true indigenous capacity regardless of the combination of external assistance withdrawn.

pass_fail_criteria.decision_rule: The frozen discovery predictor must achieve Spearman rho >= 0.65 and MAE <= 0.20 across all horizons under novel support compositions without refitting.
